description: Temporary change of use of areas of Gunnersbury Park for the staging of temporary events between 01 January 2027 and 31 December 2031. Up to 19 live event days per calendar year, with a total of 115 days including set-up, inactive, removal and trackway days. Including the erection of associated temporary structures, fencing, ancillary concessions and facilities.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 19 live event days per calendar year, with a total of 115 days including including set-up, inactive, removal and trackway days is permitted between 01 January 2027 and 31 December 2031.
Reason: This permission is being granted on temporary basis.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:
[806-P-01, 806-P-02, Socio-Economic Impact Assessment, Sound Management Plan Revision P01, Biodiversity Net Gain Assessment � Baseline, Statutory Biodiversity Metric Preliminary Ecological Appraisal, Landscape Restoration Statement 3441-5-4-LRS-5401-P2, Transport Assessment, Travel Plan Statement, Construction Traffic Management Plan, Technical Note � TfL Service Impact Note, Technical Note � Waste Management, Deliveries & Servicing Plan and Technical Note � Cycle Parking Note. Received: 29/10/2025
Planning, Design, Environment and Heritage Statement Rev A. Received: 04/12/2025
Technical Note � Traffic Impact Addendum. Received: 15/01/2026
Cover letter dated on 05 June 2026, Summary of Event Management Plans for Planning Application Revised June 2026 and Statement of Need for a multi-year planning permission. Received: 08/06/2026
806-P-04-A, 806-P-05-A and 806-P-06-A. Received: 10/07/2026
Letter from David G Bowler dated in August 2026 and Summary of Event Management Plans for Planning Application Revised June 2026. Received: 12/08/2026
Gunnersbury Estate (2026) CIC Community Engagement Strategy. Received: 14/10/2026].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the Summary of Event Management Plans for Planning Application Revised August 2026, including the permitted event banding, maximum off site music noise levels and the monitoring points. 
Reason: To safeguard the amenity of surrounding residents, in line with the intention of NPPF, London Plan Policy D1, D4, D14, T4, Policy CC1, CC2, CC4, TC2 and EQ5 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 4 - At the conclusion of a programme of events under this planning permission in any single calendar year and before 1st February in the following any calendar year, an Annual Monitoring Report covering the preceding calendar year shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

The Annual Monitoring Report shall include: 
i.	a schedule of all events that have taken place at the site during the reporting period under the permission, including the nature, date(s), duration, and approximate attendance of each event; 
ii.	a summary of all public engagement activities undertaken during the reporting period, including details of the format, date(s), and outcomes of such activities under the Community Engagement Strategy;  
iii.	a record of all verified written and verbal complaints received from members of the public during the reporting period, including the date, nature, and subject matter of each complaint; and 
iv.	a summary of any actions undertaken in response to the matters set out at (i) to (iii) above, including any operational or management changes implemented during the reporting period.  
v.	A summary of the transport arrangement, including ingress and egress, crowd management and stewarding arrangements, parking, cycle parking delivery, servicing and waste arrangement. 
vi.	Improvement works in the park and the listed buildings.  
vii.	The outcome of the Community Access Strategy. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenity of surrounding residents and the condition of the site, in line with the intention of NPPF, London Plan Policy D1, D4, D14, T4, Policy CC1, CC2, CC4, TC2 and EQ5 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a finalised Travel Plan in accordance with current Council and TfL guidance comprising immediate, continuing and long-term measures to promote and encourage a reduction in car use shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved Travel Plan shall be implemented upon occupation and thereafter monitored and reviewed in accordance with the agreed Travel Plan targets and timescales to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives, including a reduction in single occupancy car journeys and the increased use of public transport, walking and cycling.

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a finalised Delivery & Servicing Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In order to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the adjacent highway and the premises, in the interests of road safety in accordance with policy EC2 of the Hounslow Local Plan.

Condition : 7 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a finalised Construction Traffic Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In order to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the adjacent highway and the premises, in the interests of road safety in accordance with policy EC2 of the Hounslow Local Plan.

Condition : 8 - The vehicular and pedestrian accesses shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby approved Transport Assessment. Any alterations or amendments must be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In order to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the adjacent highway and the premises, in the interests of road safety in accordance with policy EC2 of the Hounslow Local Plan.

Condition : 9 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a finalised Cycle Parking Arrangement Plan for staff and event attendees shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include details of temporary cycle parking provision in accordance with the London Cycling Design Standards (LCDS) and details of any designated dockless cycle hire parking area and its management.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 10 - Floodlighting hereby approved shall only be operational 08:00 - 23.30 and turned off at all other times, except for that required for security and safety purposes. Floodlighting will take into consideration the location of and proximity to local residential premises.
Reason: To safeguard the amenity of surrounding residents, in accordance with policies CC1 and CC2 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 11 - Trees and landscape shall be protected in accordance with the hereby approved Landscape Restoration Statement. Any alterations or amendments must be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To safeguard the appearance and character of Gunnersbury Park and the ecology, in accordance with the intention of the NPPF, London Plan Policy G4 and G6, and Policies CC4, GB1, GB2, GB7 and GB9 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 14 - The rights of changing the use of the site for any purpose for not more than 28 days in total in any calendar year under Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (GPDO) Schedule 2, Part 4, Class B (Temporary Use of Land) is removed between 01 January 2027 and 31 December 2031.
Reason: To safeguard the amenity of surrounding residents, appearance and character of Gunnersbury Park and the ecology.

Condition : 15 - The arena areas shall follow the approved drawings 806-P-04-A, 806-P-05-A and 806-P-06-A.
Reason: To ensure most of the park would remain open within the 5-year period.

Condition : 16 - The Event Organiser Vehicle Route in the approved drawings 806-P-04-A, 806-P-05-A and 806-P-06-A shall include at least 2 crossing points at south playing fields to allow park users to cross the area at all times.
Reason: To ensure most of the park would remain open within the 5-year period.

Condition : 17 - The approved Community Engagement Strategy shall be implemented for the duration of the permission.

Reason: To ensure the residents will be informed about the events.
